# Deprecated-ISA constructed evidence

Generated by `python3 tests/isa/deprecated_variants_test.py --generate` from the
production `isa_coverage_probe --catalog` and the checked test-only ABC builder.
There are 47 variants x six container profiles = 282 ABCs. The instruction,
operand widths, prefix and operand packing come from that generated catalog.
Profiles 9.0.0.0, 11.0.2.0, 12.0.2.0 and 12.0.6.0 use literal-header indexes;
13.0.1.0 and 24.0.0.0 use the two reserved UINT32_MAX header words. Profiles
11.0.0/11.0.1 and unknown versions are deliberately not writer choices.

Each method initializes v0 to undefined, contains one selected deprecated
instruction, then returns undefined. Environment instructions additionally get
a fresh one-slot lexical environment. CALLTHISRANGE's encoded count is one,
because its handler subtracts the receiver. Pool string 1 and tagged literal 2
are real regional entries; method 0 is the real method. These are valid
container/decode/lift probes, not fabricated callable, iterator, generator,
home-object or class protocols. In particular the old class's implicit
method+1 literal relation and complete class layout are not an execution proof.

The test independently regenerates every byte, checks the pinned SDK
ark_disasm mnemonic, uses the production abc_scan + abc_decode tools, and
compares the production raw lifter plus both production recovery routes.
`tests/isa/deprecated_variants.json` records hashes, original PCs, exact raw
roles/effects/commits/exceptions or typed causes, profile-specific recovery,
all upstream citations, and SDK disassembler identity. The fixture registry is
`tests/isa/coverage_manifest.json`; generated occurrence JSON stays in build/.

All 47 C++ and assembly handlers exist. They are NOT NonExecutable. Two
historical profiles are intentionally semantic-policy refusals in the engine;
that does not mean the runtime rejects the instruction. No Node, round-trip or
Ark runtime pass is asserted. There is no ark_js_vm in the checked SDK, build
or PATH; the SDK ark_aot_compiler is a compiler rather than an execution oracle.
The actual dynamic inputs/protocols of non-scalar operations are not recovered
by these minimal probes. High ID32 values are also not covered by the low-index
fixtures: the pinned C++/assembly-C++ and generated-stub paths differ there.

Run the CTest `isa_deprecated_evidence_test` (all 282, schema/width/hash
mutations, and exact 200/201/400/800 writer budgets). Refusal, successful decoding
and record completion never count as per-instruction semantic verification.
